lead: A sailing cruise, an afternoon of paddle surfing, a jet-ski route or the sunset over the Mediterranean from a catamaran. The sea of Valencia awaits you.
Paddle surfing, windsurfing and banana boat rides for those seeking adrenaline and fun on the water.

items.title: Paddle Surf Introduction
items.subtitle: Certified instructor · Equipment included · 10% off with VTC · All ages · Beginner level
items.body: Paddle surfing is the water sport that has grown the most in popularity on the Mediterranean coast in recent years, and Valencia is one of the best places in the world to practise it: calm waters, sunny weather and the impressive silhouette of the City of Arts and Sciences as a backdrop. The paddle surf introduction lasts 1 hour 30 minutes and includes all the necessary equipment — board, paddle and life jacket — and a certified instructor who teaches the basic balance and paddling techniques from scratch. No previous experience is required. Available on Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays at the Marina de València.

items.title: Windsurfing Lesson
items.subtitle: Certified instructor · Equipment included · 10% off with VTC · Wind and Mediterranean sea
items.body: Windsurfing combines balance on the board with mastery of the wind and is one of the most complete and adrenaline-filled sports on the Mediterranean. The 2-hour introductory lesson at the Marina de València is taught by a certified instructor and includes all the necessary equipment: windsurf board, sail, harness and a wetsuit if the water temperature requires it. You learn the fundamentals of balance on the board, how to angle the sail relative to the wind and the first sailing manoeuvres. Available on Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays. No previous experience in water sports is required.

items.title: Banana Boat
items.subtitle: For the whole family · Suitable for children · 10% off with VTC · Fun guaranteed · Every day
items.body: The Banana Boat is the most fun and accessible activity at the Marina de València: a huge jet ski tows several passengers aboard an inflatable banana-shaped boat at high speed over the Mediterranean Sea. Jumps, spins and splashes guaranteed. The activity lasts 30 minutes and is suitable for all ages, including children. No special skill is required. It is the perfect plan for groups, families or couples looking for pure fun by the sea. Available every day of the year at the Marina de València.

items.title: Sailing Excursion along the València Coast
items.subtitle: Sailing boat · 1 hour · Mediterranean coast · Views from the sea · 10% off with VTC
items.body: An hour sailing along the coast of Valencia aboard a Mundomarino sailing boat: the most classic and elegant way to discover the city’s seafront from the sea. The route skirts the Valencian coast, offering unique views of the Paseo Marítimo, Las Arenas beach and La Malvarrosa, the port of Valencia and the Marina de València. A short but very satisfying experience that lets you see the relationship between Valencia and the sea in a completely different way from how it is perceived from land.

items.title: Catamaran Sunset — Mundomarino
items.subtitle: Mediterranean sunset · Every day at 20:00 · Spanish and English · 4.4/5 · 10% off with VTC
items.body: One of the most romantic and spectacular experiences in Valencia: watching the sunset over the Mediterranean from the deck of a catamaran. The 1-hour-30-minute trip sets sail at 20:00 every day of the year from the Marina de València and cruises while the sun tints the horizon in golden, orange and red tones over the sea. Mundomarino’s catamaran offers space and comfort on board, with a guide available in Spanish and English. A memorable experience for couples as well as groups of friends or families.

items.title: Catamaran Sunset — Boramar
items.subtitle: Mediterranean sunset · Every day at 20:00 · 10% off with VTC · Operator Boramar
items.body: The same magical Mediterranean sunset experience aboard a catamaran, this time with the operator Boramar. The 1-hour-30-minute trip also sets sail at 20:00 every day from the Marina de València, offering views of the Valencia skyline from the sea and the spectacle of the sun sinking into the horizon that are hard to forget. A second option for those who cannot find availability on the Mundomarino catamaran or who prefer Boramar’s service.

items.title: Lunch Cruise
items.subtitle: Lunch included · Views of the Mediterranean · Marina de València · 10% off with VTC · Operator Boramar
items.body: The most complete nautical experience at the Marina de València: a cruise aboard a Boramar boat that includes a lunch with views of the Mediterranean Sea. Combining sailing off the Valencian coast with food on board makes this plan one of the most special experiences you can have in Valencia. Ideal for celebrations, anniversaries, birthdays or simply to enjoy a different lunch with the sea as the star. Check availability and timetables when booking.

blocks.title: Tips for water activities in Valencia
items: The sunset catamaran trip at 20:00 is the most romantic and spectacular activity: book several days ahead in summer because places sell out fast
The paddle surf introduction is the perfect activity for beginners: 1 h 30 with a certified instructor and all the equipment included for just €25, ideal to do as a family
If you want the most complete nautical experience, the Boramar lunch cruise combines sailing and Mediterranean cuisine in one plan that is perfect for celebrations
Windsurfing requires a bit more concentration than paddle surfing: it is the most technical of the three activities but also the most rewarding once you catch the rhythm of the wind
The Marina de València is 20 minutes by metro from the centre (L6, L7, L8 Marina Real stop): much more convenient than going by car in high season
With the Valencia Tourist Card you get 10% off all water activities: always buy online at visitvalencia.com for the best price
